description: This header file declares functions and types related to disk image and disk flag management within the Cuttlefish Android virtual device host commands. It includes function prototypes for resolving instance files, creating dynamic disk files, and disk image configuration, as well as class declarations for DiskBuilder and related functions.

classes.name: DiskBuilder
classes.description: A class responsible for building disk images as part of the virtual device setup.

methods.name: ResolveInstanceFiles
methods.description: Resolves and possibly verifies the configuration files needed per instance.

methods.name: CreateDynamicDiskFiles
methods.description: Creates dynamic disk files based on the provided fetcher and cuttlefish configurations.

methods.name: DiskImageFlagsVectorization
methods.description: Processes and sets disk image flags for vectorized disk images based on configuration.

methods.name: GetOsCompositeDiskConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a vector of image partitions representing the OS composite disk configuration for a specific instance.

methods.name: OsCompositeDiskBuilder
methods.description: Creates a disk builder configured for an OS composite disk for a given configuration and instance.

methods.name: ApCompositeDiskBuilder
methods.description: Creates a disk builder configured for an Application processor composite disk for a given configuration and instance.
